analyst_view.overall: Auxerre are 15th with 11 points under Will Still and drew 1-1 at Monaco last Saturday; they host Marseille before a trip to Lille. Marseille are 5th with 18 points but lost 3-2 at Le Mans on Sunday after leading 2-0, ending five league wins in a row, and Bruno Genesio says his side concede far too many clear chances and wobble after conceding. Marseille host Levski Sofia in the Europa League on Thursday evening, so they come to Auxerre with about three days' rest; Højbjerg is fit again, while Emerson and Cornelius are still out (both already in the numbers). For Auxerre, top scorer Danny Namaso's ankle injury is already counted (about -17% on their goals). Referee François Letexier (4.0 cards a game, sent off Weah in Marseille's game with PSG this season) is already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, Marseille 1.6 and Auxerre 1.2; they already take Namaso off Auxerre and add a little for Emerson missing from Marseille's defence. Marseille's leaky defence pushes up and a Thursday Europa League game could bring some rotation, but nothing is announced, so the two roughly cancel and I stay at about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners, already lowered because both sides have won few corners lately (Auxerre 17 in their last 6). Auxerre were outplayed at Monaco but defended deep and well, and Marseille usually have the ball away from home; that style is in the counts, so I stay at about 8.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, with referee Letexier adding about 4% and past meetings adding a little on Marseille's side. Auxerre fighting near the drop and Marseille after a painful defeat could make it tense, but that is ordinary for this fixture and already reflected, so I stay at about 4.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.2 shots, 12.8 for Marseille and 11.4 for Auxerre, already raising Auxerre for how many shots Marseille have conceded lately (91 in 6). Possible rotation after Thursday could blunt Marseille a little, but it is not confirmed, so I stay at about 24.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target, already lowering Marseille (21 on target in their last 6) and raising Auxerre against Marseille's open defence. Paixão and Gouiri both scored at Le Mans and Højbjerg is back, with no other news the numbers miss, so I stay at about 9.1.
